title: Petra and the Tide
author: Quentin Joubert
blurb: Emrys Galloway, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
